Willhaben skill 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Create and manage listings on Willhaben.at via browser automation.
- Supports photo uploads, title/description/price generation, and market research for pricing.
- Handles user preferences (location, shipping, description style, pricing) and stores for reuse.
- Guides user through confirmation, packaging, and shipping estimation.
- Posts listings automatically through step-by-step browser actions.
- All listings are concise, casual, and written in German for the Austrian marketplace.
